relationships.evidence: quickbar Discipline dispatch maps the visible entry before formatting vdiscipline_int
HUD Discipline selection uses the same visible-to-compiled mapping

findings.fact: Quickbar item type zero is a Discipline and dispatches a one-argument vdiscipline_int command.
findings.evidence: 0x100a8de0 branches on item type zero, calls 0x100a94d0 and formats 'vdiscipline_int %d'.
findings.consequence: The server, not the quickbar widget, owns cast eligibility and payment.

findings.fact: The visible learned-Discipline ordinal is not the authoritative enum; the client walks the compiled table, filters unavailable entries and returns the actual slot index.
findings.evidence: 0x100a94d0 iterates the compiled index array, reads the Disciplines stat list and counts only entries whose current value is nonnegative and below the display cap.
findings.consequence: Quickbar serialization must preserve or reconstruct compiled identity when clans expose different subsets.

findings.fact: vhotkey_int and vdiscipline_int are distinct immediate client command bodies, but the reported one-frame selection deferral and exact upper-tier handoff are not closed.
findings.evidence: 0x100591b0 formats vhotkey_int; 0x10059100 formats vdiscipline_int. The focused bodies do not establish command-buffer ordering or the separate tier writer.
findings.consequence: Preserve select-then-cast as two observable stages and validate frame/tier ordering live before freezing input behavior.
